objectives: Prepare a gift deed, including a gift to a child and a gift with a reserved right of use.
Explain the risks of a transfer against maintenance and care, and how it ends.
Calculate the material interest for a building right and a right of use.
Prepare a voluntary partition and know which tax applies.
Prepare a mortgage deed and the deletion of a mortgage.

cards.front: Which gifts are exempt from local tax?
cards.back: Gifts between relatives in the **direct line** and between **spouses** ([[zmdt:44:6]]).

cards.front: What is the gift tax between siblings?
A mother donates a flat to her 10-year-old daughter. Who accepts the gift for the child?
cards.back: The **father**, as the other parent; if he cannot act, a **special representative** ([[zzd:38]]; [[sk:129:2]]).

cards.front: A father gave a flat to his son and kept the right of use. The father dies. What happens to the right?
cards.back: It **ends by law** ([[zs:59]]). In practice the son presents the death certificate to the registry office for a note.

cards.front: On which property is the local tax due in an exchange?
cards.back: On the property of **higher value** ([[zmdt:47:2]]); the acquirer of that property pays it ([[zmdt:45:1|Art. 45(1)]]).

cards.front: How is a transfer against maintenance and care terminated?
What is the material interest for a building right?
cards.back: **90%** of the market price of the land ([[znnd:96:2]]).

cards.front: What is the material interest for a right of use without a term?
When is a voluntary partition void?
cards.back: When a **co-heir did not take part** ([[zn:75:2]]).

cards.front: What is the local tax in a partition?
cards.back: Only on the **increase** of a co-owner's share ([[zmdt:47:3]]).

cards.front: A mortgage deed names the loan but not the secured amount. Is the mortgage valid?
cards.back: **No**: uncertainty about the creditor, the owner, the debtor, the property, the claim or the amount makes it invalid ([[zzd:170]]).

cards.front: Is a clause "the bank becomes owner if the loan is not paid" valid?

cards.back: The **transferor** for claims under the contract (for example the unpaid price), and a **co-sharer** owed compensation ([[zzd:168]]).

cards.front: What form does the transfer of a mortgage-secured claim need?
cards.back: Written form with **notarially certified signatures**, and **entry** ([[zzd:171]]).

quiz.question: An aunt donates a house to her nephew. Which rate range applies?
options: 0.4–0.8%, as for siblings and their children
Exempt, as for relatives in the direct line
3.3–6.6%, as for other persons
0.1–3%, as for an onerous acquisition
quiz.explanation: [[zmdt:47:1:1|Art. 47(1) item 1 ЗМДТ]]: 0.4–0.8% for gifts between siblings and their children; a nephew is the child of the aunt's sibling. The direct line ([[zmdt:44:6|Art. 44(6)]]) covers parents, children and grandchildren, not aunts; 3.3–6.6% is the rate for all other persons (item 2).

quiz.question: A father donates a flat to his 8-year-old son. Who signs as the recipient for the son?
options: The mother, or a special representative
The father, for both sides of the deed
Nobody; a child cannot receive a gift
The grandmother, as the closest relative
quiz.explanation: [[zzd:38]]: a representative may not contract with himself, so the father cannot accept for the son. [[sk:129:2]]: the other parent represents the child; when both parents are prevented, a special representative is appointed. A child may receive a gift.

quiz.question: In an exchange, Ana gives a flat worth 80,000 € and receives a house worth 120,000 € from Boris. What is the base for the notarial fee?
options: 120,000 €, the dearer property
80,000 €, the cheaper property
200,000 €, the two together
40,000 €, the difference
quiz.explanation: [[znnd:96:1:2|Art. 96(1) item 2 ЗННД]]: in an exchange the certified material interest is the market price of the dearer property. The two values are not added, and the difference is not the base.

quiz.question: In the same exchange, who pays the local tax, and on what?
options: Ana, on the house worth 120,000 €, unless agreed otherwise
Boris, on the flat worth 80,000 €, unless agreed otherwise
Each party, on the property that the party receives
Ana and Boris equally, on the two properties together
quiz.explanation: [[zmdt:47:2]]: in an exchange the tax is due on the value of the property of higher value; [[zmdt:45:1|Art. 45(1)]]: it is paid by the person who acquires the property of higher value, unless the parties agree otherwise. Ana acquires the house.

quiz.question: The transferee under a care contract stopped visiting the transferor two years ago. What can the transferor do?
options: Sue for the termination of the contract
Sign a termination alone before the notary
Send a letter; the contract then ends by itself
Nothing; the property was transferred for good
quiz.explanation: [[zzd:87:3]]: a contract that transfers real rights in real estate is terminated for non-performance only through a court. A letter or a unilateral statement before the notary does not end it.

quiz.question: The land is worth 200,000 €. A building right is granted over the whole plot. What is the material interest?
options: 180,000 €, 90% of the land
200,000 €, the whole land
100,000 €, half of the land
20,000 €, 10% of the land
quiz.explanation: [[znnd:96:2:1|Art. 96(2) item 1 ЗННД]]: for a building right the certified material interest is 90% of the market price of the land, or of the part of it over which the right is granted.

quiz.question: Three heirs partition a house and a flat. One heir, abroad, was not involved. What is the status?
options: The partition is entirely void
The partition is valid for the three
The partition is valid, if the absent heir agrees later
The partition is voidable within one year
quiz.explanation: [[zn:75:2]]: a partition made without the participation of a co-heir is entirely void. A later consent does not repair it; the heirs make a new partition with all co-heirs.

quiz.question: In a partition, Ivan's share grows from 1/2 to 2/3 of the property. On what is the local tax due?
options: On the increase from 1/2 to 2/3
On the whole property
On Ivan's whole new share of 2/3
On nothing; a partition is tax-free
quiz.explanation: [[zmdt:47:3]]: in a partition, when the share held before the partition increases, the tax is charged on the excess. The share Ivan already had is not taxed.

quiz.question: A mortgage deed does not state the amount secured. What is the consequence?
options: The mortgage is invalid
The full value of the property is secured
The bank may fill in the amount later
The mortgage secures the loan without interest
quiz.explanation: [[zzd:170]]: a mortgage is invalid when there is uncertainty about the creditor, the owner, the debtor, the property, the claim or the amount; the mortgage deed must state the amount of the claim ([[zzd:167:2|Art. 167(2)]]). Nobody can fill it in later.

quiz.question: Which clause in a draft mortgage deed is invalid?
options: If the loan is not repaid, the bank becomes owner of the flat
If the loan is not repaid, the whole loan becomes due at once
The owner insures the flat and assigns the insurance to the bank
The mortgage secures the principal, the interest and the costs
quiz.explanation: [[zzd:152]]: an agreement made in advance that the creditor becomes owner of the property on non-performance, or any other way of satisfaction that differs from the law, is invalid. An early-repayment clause, an insurance clause and the scope of the security are valid.

quiz.question: A seller agreed to receive the price in instalments after the deed. What protects the seller by law?
options: A statutory mortgage over the sold property, entered on request
Nothing; the seller can only sue for the unpaid instalments
A pledge on the movables of the buyer, entered on request
A guarantee of the notary for the payment of the price
quiz.explanation: [[zzd:168]]: the transferor of a property has a statutory mortgage over it for the claims under the contract, such as the unpaid price; it is entered at the request of the transferor. The notary gives no guarantee.

quiz.question: A bank sold a mortgage-secured loan to another bank. What is required for the transfer to be effective?
options: Written form with certified signatures, and entry in the register
Only a notice of the transfer to the borrower, in writing
A new mortgage deed between the borrower and the new bank
Nothing; the mortgage follows the claim without formalities
quiz.explanation: [[zzd:171]]: the transfer of a claim secured by a mortgage is made in writing with notarially certified signatures and is entered in the property register; otherwise it has no effect for the mortgage. A new mortgage deed is not needed.
